name: paperlesspaper
description: Send Tesserae pages to paperlesspaper frames on their own firmware, and manage the frames from Tesserae. Each new frame of a device of the paperlesspaper kind is uploaded to its paper in the paperlesspaper cloud, which dithers it; the frame shows it at its next wake-up. The plugin page lists your frames and their papers (Tesserae's beside paperlesspaper's own integrations), switches which paper a frame shows, and uploads on demand.

settings.help: Create one at https://web.paperlesspaper.de/account. It is only sent to the paperlesspaper API, in the x-api-key header.
